remarks: Charming Downtown Westport 2-Bedroom Apartment Live in the heart of Westport! This spacious two-bedroom apartment was fully renovated in 2019 and offers the perfect blend of convenience and comfort. Located off Myrtle Avenue, you'll be just steps away from the renowned Levitt Pavilion for the Performing Arts, the Westport Library, Bedford Square, The Westport Country Playhouse, and the town's award-winning restaurants. Inside, enjoy a bright and open living area, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Both bedrooms provide ample space, ensuring comfort and privacy. Whether you're looking for a vibrant downtown lifestyle or a cozy retreat, this apartment delivers. Don't miss this opportunity to be in Westport and all it has to offer!
